variables.name: session_mode
variables.label: Session Mode
variables.description: When enabled, requests include an OpenClaw session key so the gateway can route messages through a persistent agent session. When disabled, requests use stateless HTTP completions.

variables.name: session_key
variables.label: Session Key
variables.description: OpenClaw session key to use. 'main' uses the default agent session.

variables.name: endpoint
variables.label: OpenClaw Gateway URL
variables.description: URL of your OpenClaw gateway chat completions endpoint.

variables.name: stream
variables.label: Enable Streaming
variables.description: Stream responses in real-time via SSE instead of waiting for complete response.

variables.name: system_prompt_prefix
variables.label: System Prompt Prefix
variables.description: Text prepended as a system message to every conversation (e.g. identity, instructions).

variables.name: user_name
variables.label: User Name
variables.description: Your name, passed to the agent so it knows who is talking.
